from harvests import load_harvests, ROWS
from distinct import new_fields

EXPECTED = list(dict.fromkeys(k for k, _ in ROWS))


def test_called_twice():
    data = list(load_harvests())
    new_fields(data)
    assert new_fields(data) == EXPECTED


def test_three_calls_with_generators():
    new_fields(load_harvests())
    new_fields(load_harvests())
    assert new_fields(load_harvests()) == EXPECTED


def test_known_values_left_out():
    data = list(load_harvests())
    assert new_fields(data, {EXPECTED[0]}) == EXPECTED[1:]


def test_seen_is_updated():
    seen = set()
    new_fields(list(load_harvests()), seen)
    assert seen == set(EXPECTED)
